Issue #104 independent review waves

Wave 1 fixed candidate: 13fc6ad36688f3b837e04de16cd9d68f89573958
Baseline: a8092b5111b98c3d18fcacb6e1a6b49918f1e030

2 gpt-6-astra:
- correctness/durability: clean; targeted native + durability tests passed.
- security/adversarial semantics: clean; added independent tests for no default
  keyword redaction across all 7 formats and NDJSON/raw, escaped/nested secrets,
  rename chains, payload-free Unicode errors and trusted metadata/static fields.
3 gpt-5.6-sol:
- code quality/API design: one actionable finding. YAML logfmt parser.pattern:
  '' was accepted because the string zero value lost option presence. Added
  independent config.Load regression, observed expected rejection failure.
- efficiency/performance: clean; inspected isolated evidence, linear scanner
  behavior, immutable state, NDJSON allocations/path and profile output.
- test quality/producer fidelity: clean; independently checked source-backed
  fixture semantics and real-file/compiled backend coverage; tests passed.
2 gpt-5.6-terra:
- framing/restart: clean; targeted durability, multiline, pending WAL, withheld
  ack, recovery failure, framing and input tests passed.
- bounds/fuzz/errors/timestamps: clean; independent inspection and targeted
  collector/parserconfig tests passed.

Resolution: retain YAML option presence through strict unmarshalling; reject
explicit irrelevant/empty options, unknown/duplicate keys and alias-key
bypasses while preserving valid merges, defaults and programmatic roundtrips.
Regression was red before the fix; full config/parserconfig race tests passed.
No-policy security regressions also passed under race detection. The second
full review wave follows renewed validation and integration of updated main.

Wave 2 fixed candidate: 893d35fb9166d88885b9127e3f9521ce9812ac36
Base: fb9cef37499bcb3706312a46d70f70a2c304721c
2 gpt-6-astra:
- correctness/durability: valid nonterminal timezone layouts reject alternate
  Go-valid suffix spellings (fractional trailing zeros). Independent decoder
  regression fails for logfmt and both Java formats. Durability otherwise clean.
- security/adversarial semantics: clean, targeted tests passed.
3 gpt-5.6-sol:
- quality/API and test-quality reviewers independently reproduced the same
  outer parser:null hole: a nil pointer bypasses parser mapping validation.
  Both independently owned regressions are retained. Other areas clean.
- performance/efficiency: clean; final 20-pair evidence and bounded scanners
  independently checked.
2 gpt-5.6-terra:
- framing/restart: clean; targeted suites passed.
- bounds/fuzz/errors: clean after retracting an internal-constructor-only
  nested-static-object hypothesis. User YAML permits only validated flat
  string static fields, so that hypothetical configuration cannot reach daemon
  construction. No user-facing defect was demonstrated by that probe.

Resolution: validate the effective outer parser node as a mapping using the
parent YAML decoder, retaining KnownFields and merge precedence. Add omitempty
for programmatic input configuration roundtrips while rejecting explicit null.
For timestamps, locate nonterminal offsets from original spelling using one
bounded prefix parse; terminal offsets retain the fast path. Structured positive
fuzzing additionally found Go's -00:00:01 sentinel behavior; derive the instant
from the validated original offset, retaining the discovered regression seed.
All new regressions passed after recorded failures. Configuration/parserconfig
race and vet passed; the new structured timestamp fuzz target passed 60 seconds
and 595,762 cases. Renewed validation and complete wave 3 follow.
No production ingestion ordering change or test assertion relaxation was made.

Root audit before wave 3: explicit logfmt mappings to established same-role
body/traceId/spanId aliases and ASCII case variants were rejected. Independent
red tests confirmed this. Same-role checks now use the existing ASCII folding
policy and include body, while runtime source matching stays exact; protected
metadata and cross-role reserved mappings still reject. Config/parserconfig
race tests passed. Pinned lint required errors.AsType for the timestamp prefix
parse error; corrected and timestamp regressions/fuzz seeds remained green.

Additional root audit before wave 3: valid Go timestamp layouts containing
literal decimal digit runs (for example a suffix .8888888888) were rejected
as excessive fractional precision. Independent root parser/decoder regressions
failed for logfmt and both Java formats. A separate test agent added 15 valid
token-boundary fixtures and 24 precision-rejection cases, with pre-fix failure
evidence obtained through a read-only overlay of the committed parser.
The fix compiles an optional lexical spelling walk for layouts with decimal
literals, while Go retains semantic parsing authority. Common layouts avoid
allocating that walk; actual fractions beyond nine digits remain rejected.
Renewed checks, timings and the full third review wave follow this correction.

Performance remediation before wave 3: the completed two-second canonical
follow-up detected a significant 1.31% slowdown on source e30af276 despite
unchanged allocations. The first one-second set was noisy and was not used
to declare success. A bounded Sol investigation identified the extra format
string comparison in the NDJSON path. Format classification now happens once
at construction; the direct JSON path has one integer branch. A controlled
benchmark-only registry comparison also removes added test metadata as a
measurement confound. All original samples and the failing gate remain retained.

Additional signed-short-year regression: Go accepts +6 and -6 for layout 06;
the optional precision walk now consumes the validated two-character spelling.
All 20 signed single-digit spellings have independently specified expected
times. Final source 16b3c3a7 passed complete Go/race, pinned Linux lint, all
three compiled backend gates and the final4 controlled performance gate.
The diagnostic triple does not establish the string comparison as the sole
cause of the earlier full-test-binary slowdown; test metadata also changed.
No statistically significant final production regression with identical test
registration was measured. Full third review wave starts after these gates.
